e8b_identity_reconciliation.summary_of_change: the reduction from 32.686 to 31.96 h is NOT a relaxation. It comes from removing the selection-sensitivity study, whose object the fixed-endpoint rule eliminated, and from pricing the remaining readouts and interventions directly per cell instead of through a pooled evaluation-share fraction. Every other correction was neutral for this identity or increased it (the spent-compute line grew once itemised from the artefacts' own walls).

complete_programme_components.component: six B3 final core cells (fixed 22 epochs, FP32 eval, G14, gates)
B3 share of final R1/R2/R3 readouts + 3 interventions

coverage_proof.already_spent_diagnostics: bf16_characterization_v2, fp32_validation, determinism_probes_1_to_4 (INCLUDING the superseded runs 1 and 2), paired_rescoring_and_micro_probes
coverage_proof.all_six_B3_core_cells: 3 x train_40k + 3 x train_250k inside the B3 arm total
coverage_proof.fixed_22_epoch_execution: LM_EPOCHS = 22 in the generator, and the recipe encodes max_epochs 22 with early_stopping false
coverage_proof.structural_fp32_evaluation: EVAL_FP32_S = 108.0 s per canonical dev pass, charged in every epoch of every cell
coverage_proof.G14: G14_ROWS (64 pre + 160 post) x G14_ROW_S 5.301 s per LM cell
coverage_proof.final_R1_R2_R3: R1 comes free from the epoch-22 canonical pass; R2 and R3 are charged as measured/assumed per-row walks over all 7,714 development rows
coverage_proof.mandatory_interventions: three intervention conditions per LM cell, each one canonical FP32 dev pass
coverage_proof.other_gate_overhead: GATE_OVERHEAD_H 0.223 h per run, MEASURED as the residual between the grid runs' recorded wall and their epoch time (G8, G9, G11, G13, G15, G1, the selection reproduction check)

e8b_identity_reconciliation.verdict: FITS: the complete planned pretrained-identity programme projects to 31.96 h against the hard 35 h ceiling, leaving 3.04 h. The ceiling is NOT weakened and NO component was dropped to achieve the fit.
e8b_identity_reconciliation.retry_allowance: NONE. The plan tolerates zero B3 retries; any retry or any additional B3-loading evaluation triggers a stop-and-ask BEFORE execution
residual_assumptions: R3 per-row cost is ASSUMED at 1.5x the measured R2 rate; if R3 were 3x R2 instead, the B3 share would rise by about 0.19 h and the headroom would fall to about 2.85 h - still inside the ceiling
the 250k train rate is step-scaled from the measured 40k rate; no 250k E8B cell has ever run
B1's line is charged at an upper bound and touches neither identity
